FOOD_DIALOG.HEADER_DESC: C.P. Vietnam's food products are developed through a tightly controlled integrated value chain following the "Feed–Farm–Food" business model—from animal feed and farming to food processing.
FOOD_DIALOG.SEC1_DESC: C.P. Vietnam's processed food products are strictly controlled throughout the production process to ensure food safety, deliver high nutritional value, and meet the diverse needs of consumers.
FOOD_DIALOG.SEC2_DESC: C.P. Vietnam provides clean, fresh food that is carefully monitored from farming and production to distribution, ensuring both quality and freshness.
FOOD_DIALOG.SEC3_DESC: C.P. Vietnam's retail network delivers convenient access to quality food products, along with professional customer service experiences.

FARM_DIALOG.HEADER_DESC: C.P. Vietnam's livestock breeds are established from the world's leading gene sources, adapted and selectively bred under Vietnam's conditions to produce livestock that meets the needs of the Vietnamese market.
FARM_DIALOG.SEC1_DESC: The self-contained farming method, commonly used in developed countries such as Japan, the U.S., France, and so on offers outstanding advantages including ensuring optimal farming conditions, maximizing productivity,…
FARM_DIALOG.SEC2_DESC: C.P. Vietnam applies advanced technology in breeding aquatic breeds (white-leg shrimp, fish) and conducts strict inspections and disease control to provide farmers with high-quality, disease-free aquatic breeds.
FARM_DIALOG.SEC3_DESC: C.P. Vietnam's swine herds represent a harmonious combination of economic values, bringing high profits to farmers, while ensuring a clean, green and safe farming environment that meets international standards.

FEED_DIALOG.SEC1_DESC: C.P. Vietnam partners with local farmers by supplying corn seeds, providing cultivation guidance, and organizing the purchasing and preliminary processing of corn.
FEED_DIALOG.SEC2_DESC: Raw materials used in feed production are subject to strict quality control. High technologies are applied in formulating balanced feed rations, while automated production management ensures consistent and stable product quality.
FEED_DIALOG.SEC3_DESC: C.P. Vietnam's animal feed is developed for a wide range of livestock species and growth stages, ensuring balanced nutrition, high feed conversion efficiency, cost optimization, and reduced production costs for farmers.
